issues.title: Some text is hard to read
issues.who: People with low vision, older visitors, and anyone reading on a phone in sunlight.
issues.why: The text colour is too close to the background colour.
issues.fix: Make the text darker or the background lighter. Normal text needs a contrast ratio of at least 4.5 to 1. Large text needs 3 to 1.

issues.title: The page does not say which language it is in
issues.who: Screen readers pick the wrong voice and pronounce every word badly.
issues.why: The <html> tag has no lang attribute.
issues.fix: Add the language code to the <html> tag, for example lang="de" for German or lang="en" for English.

issues.title: Images have no description
issues.who: Blind visitors using a screen reader. It reads the file name or skips the image.
issues.why: The image has no alt text.
issues.fix: Add an alt attribute that says what the image shows. For pure decoration, use an empty alt="" so screen readers skip it.

issues.title: Form fields have no label
issues.who: Screen reader users hear "edit text" with no idea what to type. Voice control users cannot name the field.
issues.why: The input has no label connected to it, so it has no name.
issues.fix: Add a <label> with a for attribute that matches the input id. Placeholder text is not a good replacement because it disappears as soon as someone types.
